title: R-Type III: The Third Lightning (SNES) - Galaxy of Abyss (Normal Mode)
description:
The background seen in the final level of R-Type III: The Third Lightning, when it's played in normal mode.

This game requires the player to beat a second loop (Advanced Mode) to get the ending and credits, hence why I made a distinction in the title, since that variant of this graphic is slightly different.

A good fit for space or abstract areas.
